# Baseline geography figure (Fig. 1): study area landcover, terrain,
# healthcare facilities, and transport network for Kampala.

## Setup & Data Loading
```{r}
source(here::here("Code/utils/loading_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/utils/export_utils.R"))

load_processed_data()
filter_facilities()

# Local aliases for backward compatibility with plotting code
hospitals <- hospitals_main
health_centres <- health_centres_main
facilities <- if (inherits(Facilities, "list")) {
  idx <- which(names(Facilities) == "facilities_all_kampala")
  if (length(idx) > 0) Facilities[[idx]] else Facilities[[1]]
} else {
  Facilities
}
```

## Visual parameters and reference dataset alignment
```{r}
# ESA WorldCover colour palette and class labels (study-area subset)
landcover_colors <- c(
  "10" = "#006400",  "20" = "#ffbb22",  "30" = "#ffff4c",
  "40" = "#f096ff",  "50" = "#fa0000",  "60" = "#b4b4b4",
  "70" = "#f0f0f0",  "80" = "#0064c8",  "90" = "#0096a0",
  "95" = "#00cf75",  "100" = "#fae6a0", "0" = NA
)

landcover_classes <- c(
  "10" = "Tree cover",       "20" = "Shrubland",
  "30" = "Grassland",        "40" = "Cropland",
  "50" = "Built-up",         "60" = "Bare/Sparse vegetation",
  "70" = "Snow and Ice",     "80" = "Permanent water bodies",
  "90" = "Herbaceous wetland","95" = "Mangroves",
  "100" = "Moss and lichen", "0" = "No data"
)

# Restrict colour palette to classes present in the raster
unique_classes <- sort(unlist(unique(Landcover)))
unique_classes <- unique_classes[unique_classes != 70]  # Snow/ice absent in study area

filtered_landcover_colors <- landcover_colors[names(landcover_colors) %in% unique_classes]
filtered_landcover_classes <- landcover_classes[names(landcover_classes) %in% unique_classes]

# Derive terrain visualisation layers from DEM
slope <- terrain(DEM, "slope")
aspect <- terrain(DEM, "aspect")
hillshade <- shade(slope, aspect, angle = 45, direction = 315)

par(oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0), mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))

# Load full-extent reference datasets for contextual mapping
landcover_complete <- rast(here("Data", "raw", "Landcover", "ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N00E030_Map.tif"))
facilities_complete <- vect(here("Data", "raw", "Facilities", "suhsharan_health_facilities", "sub-saharan_health_facilities.shp"))

# Align reference datasets to the study area CRS and extent
landcover_complete <- project(landcover_complete, Landcover)
landcover_complete <- crop(landcover_complete, Landcover)

facilities_complete <- project(facilities_complete, facilities)
facilities_complete <- crop(facilities_complete, Landcover)

# Normalise column names (handle both "." and " " separators)
for (col in c("Facility_n", "Facility_t", "LL_source")) {
  old_dot <- sub("_", ".", col)
  old_space <- sub("_", " ", col)
  if (!(col %in% names(facilities_complete))) {
    if (old_dot %in% names(facilities_complete)) names(facilities_complete)[names(facilities_complete) == old_dot] <- col
    else if (old_space %in% names(facilities_complete)) names(facilities_complete)[names(facilities_complete) == old_space] <- col
  }
}

# Compute and apply coordinate shift to align reference and study datasets
# (systematic offset persists after reprojection; source of misalignment unknown)
coords_c <- crds(facilities_complete)
coords_s <- crds(facilities)

ids_c <- facilities_complete$Facility_n
ids_s <- facilities$Facility_n

common_ids <- intersect(ids_c, ids_s)
idx_c <- match(common_ids, ids_c)
idx_s <- match(common_ids, ids_s)

dx <- mean(coords_s[idx_s, 1] - coords_c[idx_c, 1], na.rm = TRUE)
dy <- mean(coords_s[idx_s, 2] - coords_c[idx_c, 2], na.rm = TRUE)

facilities_complete <- shift(facilities_complete, dx, dy)
landcover_complete <- shift(landcover_complete, dx, dy)

# Subset reference facilities by type for contextual plotting
hospitals_complete <- facilities_complete[facilities_complete$`Facility_t` %in% c("National Referral Hospital", "Hospital", "Regional Referral Hospital"), ]
health_centers_complete <- facilities_complete[facilities_complete$`Facility_t` %in% c("Health Centre III", "Health Centre II", "Health Centre IV"), ]

# Synchronise raster names to prevent 'names do not match previous names' error in plot(..., add=TRUE)
# All overlaid rasters must share the same name as the base layer.
names(landcover_complete) <- "landcover"
names(Landcover) <- "landcover"
names(hillshade) <- "landcover"
```

```{r}
# --- Render Fig. 1 to PDF ---
w <- 79.6  / 25.4  # mm to inches
h <- 123.1 / 25.4

pdf(get_fig_path("Figure 1", subdir = "Main", ext = "pdf"),
    width       = w, height = h,
    version     = "1.4",
    useDingbats = FALSE)

par(mai = c(0, 0, 0, 0), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i", cex = 8/12)

# Reference landcover (low opacity, provides spatial context beyond AOI)
plot(landcover_complete,
     col    = adjustcolor(filtered_landcover_colors, alpha.f = 0.15),
     legend = FALSE, axes = FALSE, box = FALSE)

# Study area landcover (higher opacity)
plot(Landcover,
     col    = adjustcolor(filtered_landcover_colors, alpha.f = 0.7),
     legend = FALSE, axes = FALSE, box = TRUE, add = TRUE)

# Hillshade overlay
plot(hillshade,
     col    = gray.colors(100, start = 0.3, end = 1, alpha = 0.4),
     legend = FALSE, add = TRUE)

# Infrastructure overlays
lines(OSM_roads,    col = "black", lwd = 0.7, lty = 1)
lines(water_lines,  col = "#1a6db5",  lwd = 0.7, lty = 1)

# Title: Study area geography and healthcare network in Kampala.
# Caption: Administrative boundaries of Kampala, Uganda, overlaid on ESA WorldCover (2021) land cover and the network of public and private-not-for-profit (PNFP) healthcare facilities through which maternal and child health services are delivered. Major roads and surface water features are included to provide spatial context. Data sources: Master Facility List (2019); ESA WorldCover 2021; SRTM 30 m DEM (2018); UBOS parish boundaries (2018); OpenStreetMap contributors (extract 8 January 2025, ODbL 1.0).
# Note: Source Data for Figure 1 is not exported for publication as it contains third-party facility location data.

# Reference facilities (semi-transparent, outside AOI context)
points(hospitals_complete,      pch = 23,
       col = adjustcolor("black", alpha.f = 0.5),
       bg  = adjustcolor("blue",  alpha.f = 0.4), cex = 1)

points(health_centers_complete, pch = 21,
       col = adjustcolor("black", alpha.f = 0.5),
       bg  = adjustcolor("green", alpha.f = 0.4), cex = 1)

# Study area facilities (solid)
points(hospitals,      pch = 23, col = "black", bg = "blue",  cex = 1)
points(health_centres, pch = 21, col = "black", bg = "green", cex = 1)

# --- Two-column legend -------------------------------------------------------
lc_labs <- unname(filtered_landcover_classes)
lc_cols <- unname(filtered_landcover_colors)
n_lc    <- length(lc_labs)

cex_lgd   <- 6.5/12
ysp       <- 0.75
inner_pad <- 0

# Left column: Healthcare facilities and transport infrastructure
left_labs  <- c("", "  Hospitals", "  Health centres",
                "", "  Major roads", "  Rivers / watercourses")
n_left     <- length(left_labs)

left_pch   <- c(NA, 23L, 21L, NA, NA, NA)
left_col   <- c(NA, "black", "black", NA, "black", "#1a6db5")
left_pt.bg <- c(NA, "blue", "green", NA, NA, NA)
left_lty   <- c(NA, NA, NA, NA, 1L, 1L)
left_lwd   <- c(NA, NA, NA, NA, 0.7, 0.7)

# Right column: Landcover classes
right_labs  <- c("", paste0("  ", lc_labs))
n_right     <- length(right_labs)
lc_rows_r   <- seq(2L, 1L + n_lc)

right_pch   <- c(NA, rep(22L, n_lc))
right_col   <- c(NA, lc_cols)
right_pt.bg <- c(NA, lc_cols)
right_lty   <- rep(NA_integer_, n_right)
right_lwd   <- rep(NA_real_,    n_right)

# Dry-run to compute bounding boxes
lgd_L_dry <- legend(x = 0, y = 0,
  legend    = right_labs, pch = right_pch,
  col       = right_col,  pt.bg = right_pt.bg,
  lty       = right_lty,  lwd = right_lwd,
  pt.cex    = 0.85, cex = cex_lgd,
  x.intersp = 0.20, y.intersp = ysp,
  bty = "n", plot = FALSE)

lgd_R_dry <- legend(x = 0, y = 0,
  legend    = left_labs,  pch = left_pch,
  col       = left_col,   pt.bg = left_pt.bg,
  lty       = left_lty,   lwd = left_lwd,
  pt.cex    = 0.85, cex = cex_lgd,
  x.intersp = 0.25, y.intersp = ysp,
  bty = "n", plot = FALSE)

# Position legend at bottom-left of plot region
usr     <- par("usr")
pad_x   <- 0.010 * (usr[2] - usr[1])
pad_y   <- 0.143 * (usr[4] - usr[3])
gap_col <- 0.05 * lgd_L_dry$rect$w

box_w <- lgd_L_dry$rect$w + gap_col + lgd_R_dry$rect$w
box_h <- max(lgd_L_dry$rect$h, lgd_R_dry$rect$h)

box_x0 <- usr[1] + pad_x
box_y0 <- usr[3] + pad_y
box_x1 <- box_x0 + box_w
box_y1 <- box_y0 + box_h

rect(box_x0, box_y0, box_x1, box_y1,
     col = "white", border = "grey70", lwd = 0.5)

x_L <- box_x0
y_L <- box_y1

x_R <- box_x0 + lgd_L_dry$rect$w + gap_col
y_R <- box_y1

# Render left column (landcover classes)
lgd_L <- legend(x = x_L, y = y_L,
  legend    = right_labs, pch = right_pch,
  col       = right_col,  pt.bg = right_pt.bg,
  lty       = right_lty,  lwd = right_lwd,
  pt.cex    = 0.85, cex = cex_lgd,
  x.intersp = 0.20, y.intersp = ysp,
  bty = "n")

text(x = lgd_L$text$x[1L], y = lgd_L$text$y[1L],
     labels = "Land cover classes", adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = cex_lgd, font = 2)

# Render right column (facilities and transport)
lgd_R <- legend(x = x_R, y = y_R,
  legend    = left_labs,  pch = left_pch,
  col       = left_col,   pt.bg = left_pt.bg,
  lty       = left_lty,   lwd = left_lwd,
  pt.cex    = 0.85, cex = cex_lgd,
  x.intersp = 0.25, y.intersp = ysp,
  bty = "n")

right_headers <- list(
  list(row = 1L, label = "Healthcare facilities"),
  list(row = 4L, label = "Transport & water")
)
for (h in right_headers) {
  text(x = lgd_R$text$x[h$row], y = lgd_R$text$y[h$row],
       labels = h$label, adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = cex_lgd, font = 2)
}

# --- Alternating scale bar (lower-right, 0–1–2–3 km) ---
usr   <- par("usr")
pin   <- par("pin")
uin_x <- (usr[2] - usr[1]) / pin[1]
uin_y <- (usr[4] - usr[3]) / pin[2]

sb_seg   <- 1000                         # 1 km per segment
sb_len   <- 3000                         # 3 km total
sb_h     <- 0.055 * uin_y
gap_x_in <- 0.15
gap_y_in <- 0.70

sb_x2 <- usr[2] - gap_x_in * uin_x
sb_x1 <- sb_x2 - sb_len
sb_xm1 <- sb_x1 + sb_seg
sb_xm2 <- sb_x1 + 2 * sb_seg
sb_y0 <- usr[3] + gap_y_in * uin_y
sb_y1 <- sb_y0 + sb_h

rect(sb_x1,  sb_y0, sb_xm1, sb_y1, col = "black",  border = NA)
rect(sb_xm1, sb_y0, sb_xm2, sb_y1, col = "grey88", border = NA)
rect(sb_xm2, sb_y0, sb_x2,  sb_y1, col = "black",  border = NA)
rect(sb_x1,  sb_y0, sb_x2,  sb_y1, col = NA, border = "black", lwd = 0.7)

tick_x <- c(sb_x1, sb_xm1, sb_xm2, sb_x2)
tick_h <- sb_h
segments(tick_x, rep(sb_y1, 4), tick_x, rep(sb_y1 + tick_h, 4),
         col = "black", lwd = 0.7)

lbl_y <- sb_y1 + tick_h + 0.018 * uin_y
text(tick_x, rep(lbl_y, 4), labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3"),
     adj = c(0.5, 0), cex = 6/12, col = "black")

text(sb_x2 + 0.035 * uin_x, lbl_y,
     labels = "km", adj = c(0, 0), cex = 5.5/12, col = "black")

north(type = 2, cex = 8/12)

dev.off()
```
